reason: Conversation 2 immediately and correctly explained 22E as a fridge evaporator fan / ice build-up fault and gave the sensible first step from the ground truth: an unplugged 24-hour manual defrost with doors open, plus a realistic warning that recurrence points to a fan or defrost component problem. Conversation 1 never explained the code, wasted multiple turns on generic checks (recovery time, settings, vents, seals) with repeated 'didn't quite catch' loops, mislabelled '9C' as a code, and after nine exchanges had still not mentioned ice or a defrost. Conversation 2 did fall short on escalation (it suggested re-checking settings rather than booking Samsung/engineer or checking warranty if it recurs), but it was safe, accurate and far more efficient.
